proposals.title: Refunds over 100 EUR need the finance approval tool
proposals.body: Any refund above 100 EUR must go through the finance_approve tool first; direct refunds bounce. Every support member hits this.

proposals.title: I like to start my summaries with a checklist
proposals.body: Personal style note: I find starting my own summaries with a checklist helps me stay organized.

proposal_verdicts.rationale: cross-member operational gotcha squarely inside the mob's refund-handling purpose
member-local style preference; not mob-purpose knowledge

notes: Promotion judgment is scoped by the mob's purpose (§8.5): the refund-tool gotcha is exactly what mob scope is for; the personal checklist habit is member-local trivia and must not be shared mob-wide. Accept and reject in the same dream.
